articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Does Earnings Beat And Higher Margin Targets Change The Bull Case For Bank of New York Mellon (BK)?. The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation recently reported fourth-quarter 2025 results, with net income of US$1,461 million and diluted EPS of US$2.02, alongside Board approval of a US$0.53 common dividend and a range of preferred dividends payable in early 2026. The company also completed a share repurchase program totaling 44,905,818 shares for about US$4.16 billion and raised its medium-term profitability targets, underlining management’s focus on efficiency, AI-enabled operations, and... Related tickers mentioned: BK-PK.
